SourceProxy.label: SHYX Image TEASAR Centerlines
SourceProxy.name: SHYXImageTeasarCenterline

Documentation.short_help: Centerline polylines from a vtkImageData mask or label volume (TEASAR).

SourceProxy.Documentation: TEASAR centerlines from a 1-component vtkImageData. Foreground is either voxels >= Threshold, or positive integer labels (26-connected components within each label). Output is polylines with point data MaximumInscribedSphereRadius (physical distance to background). This is not the VMTK surface Voronoi centerline.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Uniform rectilinear mask or label volume. Point-centered 1-component scalars.

StringVectorProperty.name: SelectInputScalars
StringVectorProperty.label: Scalars
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Point scalar array used as the mask or label image.

IntVectorProperty.name: ForegroundMode
IntVectorProperty.label: Foreground
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Threshold: voxels >= Threshold are one foreground class, then split into 26-connected components. Label: each positive integer value is an object (non-integers are ignored), also split into 26-connected components.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Threshold mode. A voxel is foreground when its scalar is >= this value.

IntVectorProperty.name: LabelValue
IntVectorProperty.label: Label Value
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Label mode. 0 processes every positive integer label. Any other value processes only that label.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Scale
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Scale
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Invalidation radius is scale * distanceToBoundary + const, in the same physical units as the image spacing. Larger scale keeps the backbone and drops short branches. 1.5 keeps side branches; 4 to 10 keeps mostly the trunk.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ConstRadius
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Const
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Added to the invalidation radius, in image physical units (same as spacing), not voxels. 0 disables the constant term. A value on the order of a vessel radius will erase nearby branches.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: PdrfScale
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Penalty Scale
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Weight of the boundary penalty. The path cost at a voxel is penaltyScale * (1 - radius / maxRadius) ^ penaltyExponent, plus the normalized geodesic distance from the root. Large values keep the path farther from the wall.

IntVectorProperty.name: PdrfExponent
IntVectorProperty.label: Penalty Exponent
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Exponent on the normalized boundary term. 4 is the usual setting. Higher values punish the wall more sharply.

IntVectorProperty.name: DustThreshold
IntVectorProperty.label: Dust Threshold
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Skip a connected component with fewer than this many voxels. 0 keeps all.

IntVectorProperty.name: MaxPaths
IntVectorProperty.label: Max Paths
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum polylines per connected component, including paths forced to volume-boundary contacts. 0 means no limit.

IntVectorProperty.name: FixBranching
IntVectorProperty.label: Fix Branching
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: After each path, set the penalty to zero on those voxels and recompute the shortest paths. Later branches fork nearer the junction instead of splitting early off the trunk. Off uses one shortest-path field for every branch and is faster.

IntVectorProperty.name: FixBorders
IntVectorProperty.label: Reach Volume Boundary
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If the foreground touches the volume boundary, draw a path to the max-radius voxel of each contact (ties go to the contact centroid) before the usual farthest-point passes. Turn off when a mask simply runs into the edge of the block and those contacts are not outlets.
